label: Geometric cooling
subgoals: Write the temperature after k steps as T zero times alpha to the k
Raise alpha to the number of steps

label: How many temperature steps
subgoals: Take the log of the final over the initial temperature
Divide by the log of alpha
Round up to the next integer step count

label: Initial temperature and adaptation
subgoals: Average the uphill cost changes of sampled random moves
Divide by minus the log of the target acceptance ratio
Adapt the cooling factor to the observed acceptance ratio
